title: Take deposits on bookings
summary: Customers pay a small deposit to hold their time, so no-shows don't cost you. It goes straight to your bank.

steps.title: Get paid first
steps.body: Deposits need your ID and bank account in Get paid. See "Get paid: your ID and bank account".

steps.title: Switch deposits on and pick the amount
steps.body: In Booking settings, under Deposit, pick a percentage of the price (30% works well) or a fixed amount. It's never less than ₦1,000. Choose whether it counts towards the bill. A service can have its own rule: no deposit, a fixed amount, or the full price.

steps.title: What your customer sees
steps.body: Each service shows "₦X deposit to book". Before paying they see the deposit, what's left to pay at your shop and your booking rules. The time is held for 10 minutes while they pay, then it's booked.

steps.title: When they come in
steps.body: Today and Check a code show "Deposit paid" and what's left to collect. Tap Paid when they pay the rest by cash or transfer.

tips: Tikka takes 1% of each payment, plus Paystack's fee. Nothing monthly.
Tikka doesn't refund deposits. If you agree a refund with a customer, send it from your bank.
Bookings you add yourself never ask for a deposit.
